Protections | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
 document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an 
 annually bases as
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.
This document initiated by eng. Hoda Mohamed 
 Ahmed at Alx zone, tested by eng. Heba Abdel Meniem at Dekhaila II - Sedi 
 Kirir PS, accepted by eng. Madiha Al Nagar general director, and certified by 
 eng Esam Sadeq general director of Alx network and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Maintenance 
 staff should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one 
 who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Safety and healthy 
 equipment must be used (safety helmet , safety shoes ... etc).
Disconnect the DC supply and
 Insert the test socket
Connect the current terminal of the relay on the 
 test socket to the testing equipment and be sure that the remaining current circuit is closed.
Connect the voltage terminal of the relay on the 
 test socket to the testing equipment.
Connect the tripping output of the relay on the 
 test socket to the stop contact of the testing equipment.
Remove the output from the relay, which initiate 
 breaker failure.
Remove the output from the relay, which initiate 
 event recorder and fault recorder.
